one_variable: For matched pilot pick ONE: (A) FLEXAIDDS_PHENOTYPE_UNIQUE=1 OR (B) FLEXAIDDS_BASIN_REINJECT=1. Convenience FLEXAIDDS_NEW_SEARCH_ARCH=1 enables A+B (dev only — not one-var). Never bundle BOOM+election+mutation+arch.

implemented.A_phenotype_unique: FLEXAIDDS_PHENOTYPE_UNIQUE=1 or NEW_SEARCH_ARCH token phenotype_unique — classic mutate forces ±1-bin if phenotype bins unchanged; reproduce uses phenotype-bin hash
implemented.B_basin_reinject: FLEXAIDDS_BASIN_REINJECT=1 or token basin_reinject — diversity collapse reinjects worst chroms preferring Cartesian RMSD > FLEXAIDDS_BASIN_SIGMA_ANG (default 2.0) vs best

env_gate: FLEXAIDDS_PHENOTYPE_UNIQUE / FLEXAIDDS_BASIN_REINJECT / FLEXAIDDS_NEW_SEARCH_ARCH; default OFF; control unset
magnitude_floor: mean_dBCR <= -0.5 A or >=1 BCR<2 or 1N1M elect<=2.5; no wipeout; no clean-probe elect regression
l1_l4_plan: L1: env read once at GA start; L2: not overridden by dock JSON; L3: can change selection/uniqueness/reinject path; L4: one-shot stderr marker e.g. [NEW-SEARCH-ARCH] with control zero
launch_blockers: S2 validate-pins green on closed OUTs

hypothesis: Phase-4 inject/election/granular-mutation nulls leave room for a structural search/selection defect (lifetime phenotype uniqueness vs local steps, bit-allele diversity catastrophe, or selection pressure). A single env-gated architecture change may recover elect/BCR on 1N1M/1L7F without reopening VOID scoring levers.
